examples.en: I have a pen. The pen is red.
The book is in the bag.

examples.uz: Men har kuni ko'p yaxshi so'zlar yozaman.
examples.en: I write many good words every day.
I say thank you every day.

examples.uz: Bu katta sumka, lekin u qizil.
examples.en: It is a big bag, but it is red.

examples.uz: Men salom deyman, lekin sen hayr deysan.
examples.en: I say hello, but you say goodbye.

examples.uz: Menda suv bor, lekin u issiq.
examples.en: I have water, but it is hot.
I give you the red pen.

examples.uz: Menga u kerak. Menga u kerakmi?
examples.en: I need it. Do I need it?
Do you read a book in the morning?
I drink water in the morning.
They give bread in the morning.

examples.uz: Hozirgi paytlarda ular ko'p kitob o'qishadi.

examples.en: I write with my red pen.

story.title: Kichik hikoya
story.text: In the morning, I say 'hello' to my friends. They give me a red bag and say, 'Do you have a pen for your book?' I say, 'Yes, I have a pen and a small book.' They say, 'The bag is big, but it is good.' Now, they write words in the book. I ask, 'Do you read every day?' My dad says, 'I read many books in the morning.' They eat bread and drink water. I say, 'Thank you for the pen!'
